featured_reviews.name: Sanket Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing dining experience at Wok Hei, and it truly exceeded expectations. The ambiance is warm, vibrant, and perfect for enjoying authentic Chinese cuisine. From the very beginning, everything felt well-organized and welcoming.
We started with the Chef’s Crab Soup, which was rich, flavorful, and incredibly comforting. The balance of spices and the generous crab content made it stand out, setting a great tone for the meal. It was easily one of the highlights of our visit.
For the main course, we ordered the Chicken Chinese Sizzlers, served piping hot and full of bold flavors. The chicken was tender, the vegetables were fresh, and the sauce complemented the dish perfectly. The sizzling presentation added to the excitement, and the portion size was quite satisfying.
A special mention goes to Shraddha from the staff, who made our experience even better. She was courteous, attentive, and very helpful with recommendations. Her service was prompt and professional, ensuring we were comfortable throughout the meal.
Overall, Wok Hei delivers a fantastic combination of delicious food, great ambiance, and excellent service. It’s a perfect spot for anyone craving quality Chinese food, and I would highly recommend it. Looking forward to visiting again and exploring more from their menu. 🍽️🔥

Overall, we had a fantastic time and would highly recommend Wok Hei to anyone looking for great food and excellent service. We’ll definitely be coming back again!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a very old and regular customer of this place since my visits to their Lower Parel branch, and every experience has been truly delightful. Their Thai curries are absolutely exceptional — rich, aromatic, perfectly balanced, and full of authentic flavors that keep me coming back again and again. The beautifully fragrant Bamboo Rice is equally outstanding and pairs perfectly with the curries, making the entire meal feel luxurious and comforting at the same time.
Today, their manager Mr. Dev personally requested me to post a Google review, and I am genuinely happy to do so. What impressed me the most was the gracious hospitality and respectful treatment extended by Mr. Dev, which made the dining experience even more memorable.
Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates authentic Thai cuisine, beautiful presentation, and heartfelt hospitality.

featured_reviews.name: shekhar chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Craving for some delicious Chinese or Asian cuisines- give this place a try. A perfect place for your cravings. Tried few of the food items along with drinks. It was a good experience.

Spicy garlic chicken: chicken pieces tossed in the wok and mixed well with the spices. However taste failed to bring any charm, but for the garlic feel it can be given a try.

Schezwan chicken bao: delicious and that's all. Two pieces of baos in one serving. The schezwan feel was great. A must try.

Crunchy vegetable dumpling: Comes in with sweet, cheesy, and tangy sauce. Dumplings were delicious. Soft and luscious.

Assorted vegetable dumplings: This one with was schezwan sauce. Better than the previous dumpling choice.

Crunchy chicken dumpling: With sweet, tangy, and cheesy sauce, the Dumpling goes well. However the crunchiness was missing, yet the dumplings are worth giving a try.

Minty mojito: A disaster. Not a good choice. Missed the mint feel. Not recommend.

Peach ice tea: Again, not a great choice. I feel, they put more emphasis on food than on the drinks. Just simple and plain without peach feel.

Lemon ice tea: This was the third drink, I tried, and again disappointment is what I got.

Veg personal bowl: A great option to choose from. In bowl options, you can choose your base as per your requirement. With base, you can choose the sauce of your choice and toppings of your choice. I tried multigrain noodles with fried onions, burnt garlic, crushed peanuts, spring onions. In veggies, I had baby corn, zucchini, mushroom. This bowl was one of the best things, I had at this place. A highly recommend option.

Overall, this place is wonderful if you want to cherish your taste buds with Asian and Chinese cuisines. The drinks however disappointed us a bit, the food nicely covered up for that.

featured_reviews.name: Vidyadheesh Upadhye
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wok Express is one of the early entrants in the Pan-Asian QSR scene. Their journey started in May 2015 with 5 outlets in the 1st year and after 3 years of being in business, they boast of 20+ outlets in Mumbai itself.

I was invited by the management of Wok Express for try out their menu and review them, the choice was outlet was left to me and chose the Chembur outlet.

Wok Express at Chembut is located in Cubic Mall of C G Road. The shopping mall is quite a known / famous landmark in that locality.

The ambience is pretty good, nothing fancy though. They have laid out multiple wooden tables with wooden stools. The lighting is pretty ambient and focuses on food on the table.

CHILI MUSHROOM BAO [INR 125]
A Bao is steamed rolled bread which is very popular is Chinese cuisine. You can eat it after stuffing it with any filling one wants.
The Bao which I ordered had a thick stuffing of slices mushrooms cooked in a tangy tomato base with some chili sauce. The filling was nice & juicy but the flavor of the chili was lacking. It need not have been spicy but the presence should have been felt.

TANUKI DUMPLING [INR 160]
A wonderful steamed dumpling which was basically a wonton sheet wrapped with finely chopped spring onion and some assorted vegetables. It was served topped with some chili oil & soy chili sauce. They flavor of this dish was wonderful and was served on a bed of tempura crumbs.
RECOMMENDED

CRISPY WATERCHESTNUT [INR 225]
This dish is combination of waterchestnut & baby corn fried in a corn batter.The fried balls are then tossed in a Kung Pao sauce and served topped with fried cashew nuts. The flavor & crunch of the dish was amazing.
RECOMMENDED

VEG GREEN  THAI CURRY WITH RICE [INR 160]
I was disappointed with this preparation.
The preparation of Thai Curry does involve the use of Kaffir Lime & Galangal which is used for imparting a certain flavor to the curry, which I found missing big time from the curry served at Wok Express. The curry has a certain degree of sweetness and thickness which is derived from the coconut milk used, this also was missing.

PERSONAL BOX [INR 165]
I chose a Personal Box in a small size with flat wheat noodles, chili pepper sauce, fried onion, cilantro, bean sprouts, button mushrooms, tofu and spring onion.
Red Chili Pepper sauce was supposed to be slightly spicy but the sauce used here was not spicy. The overall mixture was nice and tossed well but again I guess the undoing was the rancid crushed peanuts. It gave out a slightly odd aroma to the preparation hence I returned the preparation and was taken back by the Manager without a question.

The service level was pretty good. I placed the order for all dishes at a time to enable them to serve better. They could do better is spacing the order so that the customer can consume the first serving and then move to the next dish.

Wok Express delighted me in some dishes and equally disappointed me in some. The good ones were really good and they need to look into the areas of improvement especially the use of ingredients like Peanuts which end up spoiling the entire dish; it was a mixed bag experience for me

Food Quality – 3/5
Food Qunatity – 3.5/5
Ambiance – 3.5/5
Service – 3.5/5
Price – NA [I did not pay for the meal, since it was a review by invitation but the prices are pocket friendly]

Shivsu is becoming seriously overrated now. The prices have increased a lot, the quantity remains the same, and sadly the taste seems to be getting worse day by day. Today I ordered Chicken Schezwan Rice and noodles, and the Schezwan chutney that came along literally tasted rotten. The worst part is, this isn't even the first time this has happened.
About two weeks ago, I had ordered fried rice, and even that tasted stale/rotten. One bad experience can be ignored, but repeated incidents start raising questions about food quality and freshness. I honestly don't know what's happening with this restaurant lately.
This place used to be one of my absolute favourites, and I used to order from here without a second thought. But now the quality has dropped so much that it feels disappointing. featured_reviews.name: Rohit Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Complaint Review – Wow! Momo, Sion Outlet (China)

As a regular customer of Wow! Momo (China), I’ve always enjoyed the food and experience — but my recent visit to the Sion outlet was extremely disappointing.

The AC was not working, and the entire place felt hot and suffocating. Despite informing the staff multiple times, they showed no urgency or willingness to resolve the issue. To make matters worse, the staff came across as rude and indifferent. There were also small mosquitoes inside, which raised serious hygiene concerns.

This is not the level of service I expect from a brand I’ve trusted and visited regularly. I sincerely hope the management takes this feedback seriously and ensures basic comfort, cleanliness, and respectful service at all outlets going forward.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointed with the service at Wow! Momo, Sion West. I visited the store at 10:30 PM tonight with a voucher (WMA9RRA46297). The staff took my name, mobile number, and checked the code on their system. They even took a photo of the computer screen with their phone.
After doing all this, they suddenly claimed it can't be redeemed here and told me to 'check the steps yourself.' The worst part is, the voucher status is now showing as 'CONSUMED' on the portal, meaning the store has claimed the money, but refused to give me the food. This is completely unprofessional and feels like a scam. Since today was the last day of the voucher, I have lost my money because of their staff's behavior.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Probably had the worst experience I could have at a Wow outlet. Despite having negative experiences with Wow before, decided to give them another chance. It was evening time and the store was almost empty, with only me and more customer. Yet the experience was horrible for both of us – the AC was non-functional (the weather outside was much more pleasant than the inside), staff were unbothered about customer requests (not enough clarity provided on the menu), and the food was served after 25 minutes! It took them 25 minutes to serve  8 pieces of momos. The delay was because the staff had forgot to switch on the steamer, and only realized this after 20 mins, hence the momos were uncooked. Apart from the quality of the momos, they were lacking in taste as well. The only good experience was the chilled bottle of Pepsi.
While the prices are cheap, the food quality, taste and experience are not worth it!
[Went through other reviews after my visit and many have pointed out the bad air conditioning]

featured_reviews.name: Cannyconnoisseur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried China gate over the weekend after reading a lot of confusing reviews on it:

ENTRANCE & PARKING 🚙: Located At the backside of Chroma, where valet takes your car and parks it in the lift
On the 17th Floor find Global Fusion. The restaraunt wierdly is located inside it

OFFERS 💰: Prebook directly via the restaraunt and get 31% off or use Dineout / District to get 20% off. Bookings are a must on weekend as limited seating is available

What we ate here : (Went for Dinner on Saturday Night)

STARTERS 🌮

1) Steamed Jade Roll : 5/5 (MUST HAVE) 🌠
Delicious, tasted like a steam wonton with spring roll stuffing in butter garlic sauce

2) Paneer in Fragnant Chilly Sauce : 2/5
Paneer was not fresh and it just dint taste good

3) Wild Mushroom Crystal Dumpling : 4.5/5 (6 pieces)
Worth ordering it, was very tasty

4) Grilled Chicken in Black Bean : 4/5
Good flavour and tender chicken.

5) Veg Dumpling Clear Soup : 3.5/5
Soup was slightly cold by the time it arrived and lacked flavour

MAINS

1) Stir Fry Veg Ramen Noodles : 5/5 (MUST HAVE) 🌠
Silky smooth noodles tossed up in a lovely semi dry sauce

2) Veg Burnt Garlic Fried Rice: 3/5

3) Exotic Veg in Smoke Chilli Sauce : 3.5/5
Extremely spicy have at your own risk. If ordered mix with rice or noodles, that helps

DESSERT

1) Chocolate Gooey Cake : 4/5

SERVICE : 3.5/5
Needs a lot of improvement and training, at full capacity they were all around the place

SERVICE CHARGE - Asked them to remove it, they said they will call manager who took 10 min to come,in short be ready to pay it

AMBIENCE - Decent, cozy and comfortable

PRICING -  Came to around Rs 600 per person after discount. Quite reasonable

WILL I VISIT AGAIN : Yes this is a good option to go to for Chinese as another added option ✅

Because of the location and affordable rates, this place can be a bit packed. One would have to wait for a seat. Seating is really small, about 3_4 people only at each table. Except the last table where about 5_6 people can be crammed.
Service is quick because of high turnover at the tables.
Gents washroom is on the ground floor of the restaurant, whereas  ladies would have to go to the back of the building where the washeoon is.
Our group had a very nice time here, but could have been better if the place was a bit more roomy.

I'm sure they used seawater straight from Juhu Beach because it was so salty. There was no in-between; the noodles were either traumatized or undercooked. The soup also had a strange, sludge-like taste, as if it were offended by my order.

The fried noodles on top tasted like old oil and sadness. My taste buds literally shut down halfway through.

After coming here for some comfort food, I started to question my life choices. If there were a recipe for disappointment, it would be this soup.

Absolutely fantastic lunch experience with a group of 7.

Atmosphere:
The place is nicely designed and has very nice details such a beautiful chair patterns and high seeking with overall great light throughout the restaurant.

Food:
The food was outstanding in taste, texture and presentation. The creativity with which the dishes were presented was mind blowing. I could see the attention to detail in every single item we ordered. Especially the deserts were so pittoresk.

Service:
The staff was very friendly & super attentive. The staff by the bathrooms was especially kind!

Highly recommend this place.

featured_reviews.name: Vrunda Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yauatcha has been on my list for the longesttt time. And the wait was totally worth it.
I had heard that it served Japanese food with limited vegetarian food options. But I was wrong. Food- It’s Oriental food and so so delicious. Quality of food is so good that you can make out the difference. So we ate Cheng fu to start with, then Edamame & water chestnut rice (smelled so delicious) and tasted so good that one can eat the rice by itself. Tofu, water chestnut, bean in a black bean sauce vegetable. Great combo. We needed the meal with Mango Coconut dessert and it was such a unique and perfect ending to a great meal.
Staff - Courteous and gave good suggestions. Friday night the restaurant was packed even when we left at 10:30. That says a lot.
One meal I truly enjoyed eating. Content thru & thru after a long time. Expensive but Highly recommend.

featured_reviews.review_text: Yauatcha has to be the quintessential place to visit if you want to try perfect Cantonese dimsum cuisine in Mumbai. The Dimsums we had were all great. Must haves are Turnip cake , Crispy prawn cheung fung, Sumai and the Ramen Noodles. Service is fabulous and Ambience is niche. If you can spend 2000 rs per person, and wana celebrate something special, do visit this place.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular customer of this restaurant and always appreciated the quality of food here – it’s tasty, hygienic, and has been one of my favorite places to dine for a long time.

However, recently I’ve noticed a big drop in the service quality. Orders take much longer than expected to be prepared, even for simple dishes. What makes it worse is that when customers raise a concern, instead of handling it politely, the staff (especially the waiter) argues and tries to defend the delay rather than resolving the issue.

Good food is important, but service plays an equally big role in the dining experience. I genuinely hope the management looks into this, because this place has the potential to be excellent again if they improve their service and customer handling.

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
recently ordered from big bowl Chinese corner through Zomato, and I have to say, I was extremely impressed. The ordering process was smooth and easy, with clear descriptions and great delivery options.

The food arrived on time and was beautifully packaged, ensuring everything stayed hot and fresh. I order the chicken triple rice it was were absolutely delicious. The chicken triple rice was packed with flavor—perfectly cooked and seasoned, with generous portions. The rice was equally satisfying, with great texture and the right balance of spices.

The quality of the ingredients really stood out, and it's clear that they use fresh, high-quality produce and meats. The presentation was also spot-on, which is a rarity for delivery!

Overall, I had a fantastic experience, and I’ll definitely be order from big bowl again. Highly recommend it for anyone looking to enjoy a great meal at home!

You can adjust the specifics of the dishes, your experience, and the service as needed. The key is to mention the ease of ordering, the quality of the food, and how the restaurant exceeded your expectations!
